name: Apple-Cranberry Tuna Salad Toasts with Creamy Walnut Romaine Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
3 Granny Smith apples
3 hearts romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, onion powder, and salt in a large bowl. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl along with the cranberries.
Drain tuna and flake into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the tuna salad, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in another large bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl with the lettuce along with additional cranberries, dressing, and salt. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup walnuts
⅓ cup dried cranberries
⅓ cup ranch dressing
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Divide bread between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide toast between plates and top with tuna salad. Serve with romaine salad on the side and enjoy!
